# openwrt_fs_file (Resource)

Manages a file on the OpenWrt filesystem via LuCI /rpc/fs.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String, Sensitive) File content as UTF-8 string.
- `path` (String) Absolute path to the file on the router.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID, equal to path.
